description: Records the current draft script with an AI voice (Miles, Maya, Grant or Nora). It follows request_voiceover_script or draft_narration, once the person has read the draft (read_narration_script shows its exact words) and chosen a voice. Uses 1 voice generation once approved, and the recording goes into the video only when they apply it. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

voice.description: The AI voice: Miles, Maya, Grant or Nora.
